2024_191_jan_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for January 2024 itemizes every district p-card transaction posted to the "JAN 2024 PCARD EXP" journal entry, listing for each row the posting date and abbreviated merchant name, the budget unit, the account code, and either a transaction amount or a credit. The 17-page listing carries a footer date of 3/13/2024 and came before the Board of Education on March 19, 2024. Charges subtotal $159,699.53 against $7,656.41 in credits, producing total expenses of $152,043.12.
2024_191_jan_2024_pcard_report.page:
**What it is**
Monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction listing for Troy School District covering January 2024, presented to the Board of Education at the March 19, 2024 meeting. The document runs 17 pages, each footer stamped 3/13/2024, and repeats a header line reading "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, January 2024" on every page.

**Format**
Six columns: Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, Credits. The JE Description is "JAN 2024 PCARD EXP" on every line. Transaction descriptions concatenate a posting date with a truncated merchant name (e.g. "1/17/2024-B&H PHOTO MO"). Posting dates range from 12/27/2023 through 1/25/2024. Budget units are 15-digit strings with leading fund prefixes including 101, 120, 122, 529, 530, 531, 700 and 701; account codes seen include 3120, 3190, 3210, 3220, 3430, 3450, 3510, 4120, 4130, 4220, 4230, 5000, 5110, 5310, 5710, 5910, 5990, 6420, 6460, 7410, 7910 and 7919.

**Credits**
The credit column is populated on a small number of rows. The largest are three INTRASTATE D credits dated 12/28/2023 against budget unit 700071399524000 (677.64, 1,765.41 and 632.67) and three more the same day against 700070399524000 (581.03, 480.22 and 850.88). Other credits include an AMZN MKTP US credit of 1,742.40 (101790284000000, code 6460), SQ *METRO DE 285.00, MASB 198.00, five WAYNE RESA credits of 25.00 each, AMZN credits of 95.25, 39.99, 39.21, 29.99, 17.82, 14.39 and 1.97, HAMPTON INNS 44.88, TARGET.COM 10.00, HOPPER TRAVE 9.85, JIFFYSHIRTS. 9.56 and EPIC SPORTS 5.25.

**Spending patterns**
Amazon storefronts (AMZN MKTP US, AMAZON.COM*R, AMAZON RET*, AMZN DIGITAL, WWW.AMAZON*) account for the largest share of individual lines, mostly at supply codes 5110, 5990 and 5000. Staples, Quill, School Specialty and Sam's Club recur for office and classroom supplies. Travel and conference activity appears through Delta, American Airlines, Allianz Travel, Hotels.com, Hyatt Centric, The Westin, Residence Inn, Amway Grand, Metro Cars and Classic Luxury charges under code 3220. Professional associations and agencies billed include MASB, MI ASSOC SCH, Oakland Schools, Wayne RESA, SHAPE America, NASSP, MSVMA, NASP, MABE MI, MSU and EMU. Software and subscription vendors include Wordwall.net, Gimkit, Nearpod, Edpuzzle, Smore.com, Jotform, Wiris.com, Imagine Learning, Navigate360, Adobe, Canva, Spotify, IFTTT Pro, GoDaddy, Flexibits and a ChatGPT subscription. Facilities, grounds and fleet purchases run through Zoro Tools, Halogen Supply, EZ Pool & Spa, Floor Mat Shop, General Hardware, The Home Depot, Pirtek Sterling, Detroit Battery, Troy Auto and Speedway.

**Document identity**
"TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, January 2024" is the district's monthly purchasing-card transaction register, placed on the Board of Education agenda for the meeting of March 19, 2024. It is a 17-page tabular listing; each page repeats the title banner and column header row, and each page footer carries the page number followed by the print date 3/13/2024.

**Structure and columns**
Six columns are printed: Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, and Credits. The JE Description is identical on every row: "JAN 2024 PCARD EXP". The Transaction Description field joins a posting date to a truncated merchant descriptor as it arrived from the card processor, so merchant names appear clipped ("AMZN MKTP US", "STAPLS762430", "THE BOOMERAN", "HAPER/ZONDER", "WPY*VSN PHOT", "SCHLPAY*LANS"). Posting dates run from 12/27/2023 through 1/25/2024, so a handful of late-December charges are swept into the January cycle. Budget units are 15-digit account strings; the leading segments observed include 101 (with sub-units such as 101005 through 101017 for elementary buildings, 101050-101053, 101070, 101071, 101074, 101101, 101150, 101180, 101200, 101203, 101206, 101300, 101310, 101400, 101425, 101570, 101590, 101620, 101668, 101689, 101700, 101790, 101902, 101904, 101905, 101928, 101970), plus 120204, 120315, 122050, 122052, 122070, 122071, 122883, 122885, 529202, 530212, 531004, 531213, 700, 701 and 700928. **Totals**
